findings: Both captures cover registering, connecting to a network, applying updates, and iterating on a sandbox-only SmartPOS DevKit, separate from production payment options. Client Android or React Native uses Apps on Devices discovery and connection on the registered reader. A React Native app can initialize with an on-device connection token provider.

After handoff connection, the Stripe Reader app handles payment operations and foregrounds full screen, then returns control to the integration on completion or cancellation and continues in background. Offline payment collection is supported. The explicit DevKit kiosk destination depends on deployment route in the November capture.

substantive_changes: November adds documented production-reader alternatives for payment acceptance (server-driven integration or supported standalone mode) for users with no DevKit and replaces the broad May Verifone notice with dated model-country availability and a Sales requirement for ordering or joining a preview.

Android Gradle dependency examples become 6.0.0 (May used 5.4.1). The documented Apps on Devices minimum stays Terminal Android SDK 2.22.0. Android SDK 6.0.0+ newly requires compileSdk ≥ 35, separate from retained targetSdkVersion ≥ 24 guidance for Android 15 device support.

Reader software 2.42+ is required for custom transition animations. The new React Native configuration documents preset/custom/disabled/system-default transitions. Debug invalid animation resource IDs can cause the SDK to throw at connection; release uses the system default.

Device settings gain documented destination-specific deep links and PIN rules. All settings, network, advanced, and registration code always require the PIN. Appearance, language, and bug report prompt by default and may be configured for no prompt. The SDK payment transition and separate Android settings animation use different configuration.

November adds T600 landscape guidance via nosensor and UX700 DevKit same-Wi-Fi adb. It documents the directly installed DevKit app's default Stripe Reader return after a completed transaction and the Dashboard deploy-group preferred kiosk choice at boot and after each transaction.
